items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Octave told me that Dad went out to, when he took Dad to Mexico, you know, little Dad, Octave told me, Crosby told me, I said, took Dad to Mexico

ctx.x: Yeah, and I finished talking about little Dad. Yeah, I finished that too. I finished talking about little Dad and Cornish. So, Cornish used to kid Dad, you know, all the time. Well Dad's a little bit of a fellow, you know, he'd say, I'm a man boy. He'd say, but I'm a small man. But I got plenty of brains out of him. I got plenty of brains out of him. And he'd go and he'd start, oh, you know, he wasn't fighting, but Cornish would be playing with him, you know. But he'd be juicing, he thought, you know. He'd start…
I've been asked about him playing across the lake, too. Did you ever do that?
